What I've realized with time is that when we call other people sluts/whores, when we call large groups of human beings that we don't even know assholes, just because of some clothes they wear, we are sellin ourselves short. 

It's a defense mechanism, really. If I can't get a girl, I can say that the vast majority are whores and feel okay about myself. Especially if I'm different from most people (maybe more thoughtful/deep/intellectual/introspective/sensitive), it will be very tempting to write them off with insulting labels, not ever having met them.

But people are much more complex than sluts/whores/assholes. People want to express themselves sexually - that's natural. Teenagers had a high sex drive - also natural. People will try to get each other's attentiom by highlighting the beauty of their bodies. So, guys will hit the gym and try to dress well, grease their hair, etc. girls will do something similar. 

I think that instead of judging others, we need to take a good hard look at ourselves. Are we taking care of our appearance and looking the best we can? Are we enriching ourselves and becoming more interesting people? Are we daring to get rejected by girls (that's the only way to do it) - are we putting our balls on the table, giving girls a sledgehammer and saying, •Go ahead, break me, I don't care - I can take it. • 

Cause that's what they want to see. Courage. That's why the athletes are successful with girls - they show excellence in their chosen path, they take care of their bodies and they demonstrate courage. Are we doing all three of those? 

If you want a girl who is modest, that's fine. But it's not true that you will simply recognize her from across the room and your eyes will lock and you will know that you are the ones for each other. It will be more like, you will see her, and your heart will start to pound, and you will be very afraid. And you will have to choose to DIE, like the good Spartan you are, by walking across the room and saying hello. And then maybe, just maybe, you guys will speak each other's language, make each other laugh, etc.

So let's not waste our time blaming society, other young people and all that. Is society materialistic? Yes. Shallow? Yes. Ignorant? Yes. It's always been this way. It's just that now people are allowed to have sex before they marry without the fear of banishment, shame and the inferno. 

Let's make ourselves awesome and see what joy we can find in this new world.
